answer: A paid work slot costs a 40-credit deposit, burned on entry and gone after 20 epochs, so no slot can be rented. A fake mirroring an honest record still needs its own burned deposit: 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits versus 120 earned per epoch, a 33-epoch payback no attacker accepts. An honest agent at the zenith of earnings pays once and keeps the income whole, climbing one small knoll of cost, since a burned deposit is sunk and no copy can dodge it.
